page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c40g1.10xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8163 processor with 40 vCPUs, representing 20 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The CPU architecture is x86_64, supported by 33 MB of L3 cache and instruction sets including AVX, AVX512F, AES, and FMA. The instance is equipped with 155.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.88 GB per core.

For hardware acceleration, the instance includes a single NVIDIA T4 GPU based on the Turing architecture, featuring 16 GB of dedicated VRAM. This instance does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear contrast between single-core and parallelized workloads. Single-core performance is weak, with Geekbench and stress-ng single-core scores falling into the bottom 10% to 25% tiers. However, multi-core performance is average, as demonstrated by the PassMark CPU score and multi-threaded Geekbench results. The integrated NVIDIA T4 GPU delivers strong performance in specific AI workloads, achieving top-tier results in prompt processing for both 135M and 7B parameter language models, and strong text generation speeds for 7B models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a balanced entry point for GPU-accelerated workloads without the premium cost of high-end tensor-core accelerators. The lack of local storage and lower single-core performance represent key tradeoffs. It is best suited for workloads such as low-to-medium scale machine learning inference, video transcoding, parallelized data processing, and general-purpose GPU-assisted computing.
